messages:
jordan: FYI — deploy-bot attempted canary promotion for summarizer v2.7. Prompt-eval suite flagged a coherence regression. Holding promotion until triage.

deploy-bot: Deploy attempt: summarizer:v2.7 -> canary-3. Status: completed, post-deploy tests running.

qa-bot: prompt-eval summary (short-run): summary_coherence: baseline=87.4% -> v2.7=81.2% (delta -6.2%)
hallucination_rate: baseline=2.1% -> v2.7=3.6% (delta +1.5%)
Note: quick-run used prompt-set A (50 examples). Full suite queued.

anna: Gate threshold is -3% for summary_coherence. -6.2% exceeds that. Thanks for holding.

mike: On my local reproduce, longer contexts amplify the drop. Could be tokenizer or recent attention tweak from #eng-runtime.

sumit: Change window: open until 18:00 UTC. If we rollback now we should avoid another disruptive rollout in that window. Any perf regressions from v2.6->v2.7?

ting: From product POV we should pin to last known-good if regression >3% on core evals. This looks actionable.

jordan: Proposal: pin prod to summarizer:v2.6 immediately, continue canary in staging for bisect. Run full prompt-eval suite and the longer-context tests. If bisect shows tokenizer change, we patch and re-run.

mike: Agreed. I'll prepare a changelog entry and release notes for rollback and follow-up hotfix. Quick note for docs: the user-visible summary behaviour changed on long inputs.

release-bot: Changelog draft created: https://internal.releases/redwood/summarizer/v2.7/regression-draft (private).

jordan: Action items:
- deployctl pin summarizer:v2.6 --env=prod (I'll run)
- run full prompt-eval set B + long-context harness (anna)
- bisect PRs since v2.6 (mike)
- schedule hotfix window if needed tomorrow 09:00 UTC (ting)

deploy-bot: Action executed: pinned summarizer:v2.6 in prod at 1719203600 by jordan. Canary promotion aborted.

anna: Starting full eval now, ETA ~25m. Posting results when complete.

sumit: Confirmed no other active rollouts in the window. Rolling pin is low-risk.

ting: Product ack, will notify affected stakeholders and update release notes.

mike: Opening bisect run and linking PR slate. Will comment here with culprit PR if found.

jordan: Thanks everyone. If full eval passes on staging for targeted fixes we can plan a controlled re-promote in the next change window. Otherwise we'll ship a hotfix.

anna: Full eval finished: summary_coherence full-set delta -5.9%, hallucination +1.4%. Confirming regression.

mike: Found likely culprit: PR #4213 (attention norm tweak) — running a revert test now.

jordan: All right. For now: prod pinned, canary aborted, triage underway. Leaving this thread open for updates. :thumbsup:

release-bot: Release note (rollback entry) published: https://internal.releases/redwood/summarizer/v2.6-pin-1719203600
